description.title: אישור מטפל סיעודי - בן משפחה/ מטפל אחר
description.summary: This table is an affidavit for a family member or other caregiver providing nursing care. It collects information about the caregiver and their relationship to the patient, and confirms the duration and extent of care provided.
description.embed_passage: טופס זה הוא הצהרה של מטפל סיעודי, בן משפחה או מטפל אחר, המאשר את העובדה שהוא מספק טיפול סיעודי לחולה. הטופס כולל פרטים מזהים של המטפל והחולה, את קשר המשפחה ביניהם, ואת משך הזמן והיקף הטיפול הניתן. מטרת הטופס היא לאמת את העובדה שהמטפל אכן מספק טיפול סיעודי לחולה, ושהטיפול ניתן באופן סדיר ומספק. טופס זה משמש את קופת חולים כללית לצורך בדיקת תביעות בגין טיפול סיעודי. פרטים נדרשים כוללים מספר תעודת זהות של המטפל והחולה, כתובת המטפל, ותאריך תחילת הטיפול. הצהרת המטפל כוללת אישור כי הוא מספק טיפול אישי וסיעודי במשך רוב שעות היום והלילה.

טבלה: אישור מטפל סיעודי - בן משפחה/ מטפל אחר
This table is an affidavit for a family member or other caregiver providing nursing care. It collects information about the caregiver and their relationship to the patient, and confirms the duration and extent of care provided.
ממדים: Caregiver Affidavit, Affidavit Details

ADDENDUM 1B - AFFIDAVIT OF A FAMILY MEMBER/ OTHER CAREGIVER REGARDING PROVISION OF NURSING CARE
I, the undersigned                                                      I.D. No.                                                      of                                                      Street (full address), after being admonished that I am to state the truth and that in the event that I fail to do so, I shall be subject to the penalties prescribed by law, I hereby declare in writing as follows:
As and from                                                      I have been caring for [name]                                                      I.D. No.                                                      (here- inafter the ״ patient' ) and have been assisting him by providing personal and nursing care during most hours of the day and night (over 12 hours a day).
My family relationship with the patient:
I reside/ do not reside with the patient (mark the relevant answer).
*Attach a copy of the caregiver's I.D. card and addendum.
I undertake to notify Harel Insurance Company Ltd. in writing in the event of any change in the facts stated in this affidavit.
I  am aware that this affidavit is given in support of the patient's nursing care claim under the nursing policy for Clalit Mushlam members, filed by the patient as part of a nursing care claim with Harel Insurance Company Ltd., as the policy operator; in addition, Harel shall be entitled to verify the veracity of the information in this affidavit. I am also aware that providing a false affidavit in this matter may constitute abetting an act of fraud in a claim for insurance benefits, including everything implied thereby.
I hereby declare that this is my name, this is my signature and the contents of this affidavit are true.
Date
Full name
Signature
I, the undersigned advocate hereby declare that on                                                      , Mr./Ms.                                                      appeared before me in my office                                                      and after I admonished him/her that he/she is to state the truth and in the event of his/her failing  to  do  so,  he/she  would  be  subject  to  the  penalties  prescribed  by  law,  he/she  signed  the  above  affidavit  in  my  presence.
Adv.
